integrity: A self-contained integer proof is given; no independent mathematical audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classical Bessel normalization and nonconstant even degrees only, all orders n at least two. The exhaustive checker is finite; an unrestricted Legendre-and-Lucas proof is supplied. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to older monographs and archival articles.
title: Exact even-degree coefficient content of the classical Bessel polynomials
